subject: Sprint plan: prepay reconciliation and drawdown checkpoints
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Elena Martins <elena@brightlane.com>, Brightlane APAC Finance <finance-apac@brightlane.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-26T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Sprint plan: prepay reconciliation and drawdown checkpoints

Hi Elena / APAC finance team,

Thanks again for the sync today. As discussed, we want to run a short operational sprint to lock the annual prepay invoicing cadence and the monthly drawdown reconciliation so your treasurers and local tax team have a clean handoff come Oct. Goal: finalize invoice samples, confirm VAT mappings for each Brightlane subsidiary, and agree on the weekly reconciliation checkpoint owners.

Proposed sprint plan (2 weeks):
- Today (Sep 26): share canonical drawdown tracker and invoice sample (attached).
- Sep 27–30: Brightlane fills VAT country codes and PO/GL mappings in the tracker.
- Oct 1: Redwood to send revised invoice samples and a one-page settle matrix for local payables.
- Oct 4: Live 30-minute reconciliation call (mutual action, finalize sign-off).

Open asks for you:
1) Confirm the bank remit + account nickname used for the annual prepay (we currently have: Brightlane UK Ltd - GBP) — if any local entity differs, please list.
2) Fill the VAT country code column in the attached prepay_drawdown_tracker_v1.xlsx and return by EOD Sep 30.
3) If APAC requires an alternate invoicing entity (Brightlane APAC Pte vs Brightlane Analytics Pty), flag now — that will change tax flow.

Attachments: prepay_drawdown_tracker_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet) — canonical tracker.

I'll follow up with a calendar invite for the Oct 4 checkpoint once we have the filled tracker.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Head, Customer Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Elena Martins <elena@brightlane.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: Brightlane APAC Finance <finance-apac@brightlane.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-26T11:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sprint plan: prepay reconciliation and drawdown checkpoints

Sofia — thanks for the clear plan. We're aligned on the cadence. A few clarifications from our side:

- We'll confirm the remit accounts by Sep 29. For APAC, the operating entity is Brightlane Analytics Pte Ltd (SG), so invoices to APAC should route to that entity for tax residency.
- I've attached a sample invoice our APAC tax team prefers (brightlane_invoice_sample.pdf). Please match the sample fields where possible — they need invoice number + VAT ID + local remit line.
- VAT country codes: we'll fill the tracker column but need the following mapping guidance from Redwood: does the invoice need Redwood's UK VAT or the local EU VAT ID when we pay from our EU sub?

Also, can your team confirm whether supporting audit logs (per-invoice token usage) can be attached as a CSV in monthly reconciliations? Our auditors requested token-level evidence for Q4.

I'll aim to return the tracker populated by EOD Sep 30.

Thanks,
Elena Martins
Head of Finance Ops, Brightlane Analytics
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Elena Martins <elena@brightlane.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-27T09:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sprint plan: prepay reconciliation and drawdown checkpoints

Elena / Sofia — looping in a few specifics so we can close the VAT/ledger questions quickly.

1) VAT on invoices: If Brightlane pays from an EU entity, Redwood will issue the invoice with Redwood EU Services (EU VAT ID) for EU-resident payments. For UK remit we currently default to Redwood UK Ltd (UK VAT) unless you instruct otherwise. If you need a specific invoicing entity per payment country, note that in the 'invoice_entity' column in the tracker.

2) Token-level evidence: yes — we can attach a monthly CSV export that includes usage rows (date, route_id, model, tokens_prompt, tokens_completion, invoice_reference). That will be generated by the billing pipeline. Please confirm the preferred CSV format and any additional columns.

3) PO / GL mapping + drawdown rules (quick summary):
- Annual prepay amount will be invoiced in one invoice for the committed spend (invoice_date = Oct 5).
- Each monthly drawdown will be recorded as a ledger reduction and a supporting invoice stub in the monthly reconciliation pack.
- Drawdown priority: monthly consumption > reserved throughput credits > one-off add-ons.

I've attached an ops authorization template (ops-authorization.docx) that lists approvers for sweep windows — please sign and return if the approver list differs.

Next steps I propose: Sofia and I will update the tracker once Brightlane returns the VAT mappings; Karthik, can you draft the short invoice stub template for the monthly reconciliation pack (one line + link to token CSV)?

—Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Director, Billing & Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>, Elena Martins <elena@brightlane.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-28T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sprint plan: prepay reconciliation and drawdown checkpoints

Thanks all — quick summary and owners, so nothing slips through: 

Action items and owners:
- Brightlane to populate tracker: VAT country codes + invoice_entity + PO/GL mappings — owner: Elena (due: 2027-09-30).
- Redwood to provide invoice stub template and token-CSV schema: owner: Karthik (due: 2027-10-01).
- Redwood to confirm remit-account list per entity and finalize Oct 5 prepay invoice: owner: Sofia (due: 2027-09-29).
- Both teams to review finalized tracker and attend Oct 4 reconciliation call: calendar invite to follow (Sofia).

Notes:
- On the token CSV schema: we'll include these columns by default: invoice_reference, usage_date, route_id, model, tokens_prompt, tokens_completion, total_tokens, cost_usd. If Brightlane needs additional columns (e.g., internal cost codes), list them in a reply and we'll add them.
- DocuSign: I uploaded the MSA amendment for the annual prepay → https://www.docusign.com/preview/ABC-Prepay-MSA-DL8742 (also attached as docusign-prepay-msa-link.txt). Please route to legal if any redlines are necessary; otherwise, sign-off will enable our finance team to issue the Oct 5 invoice.

I'll draft the simple invoice stub this afternoon and drop it into the tracker as a separate tab. Once the tracker is populated, Sofia will send the calendar invite for Oct 4 (adjust if APAC timezone conflicts).

Cheers,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
